The V23079-D2003-B301 (TE Internal Part Number 4-1393789-5) is a high-performance general-purpose signal relay belonging to the Axicom P2 Series manufactured by TE Connectivity. It features a compact slimline footprint designed for Surface Mount Technology (SMT) or PCB integration, widely utilized in telecommunications, testing equipment, medical hardware, and automotive setups.

Key Technical Specifications

• Contact Configuration: DPDT (2 Form C / 2 changeover contacts) bifurcated contacts for reliable low-signal switching.
• Coil Voltage: 12VDC.
• Coil Type: Polarized, Monostable (Non-latching).
• Coil Resistance: ~1.03 kΩ.
• Contact Rating (Current): 2 A rated.
• Maximum Switching Capacity: 250 VAC / 220 VDC maximum switching voltage.
• Contact Material: Silver Nickel (AgNi) with Gold (Au) Plating.
• Coil Power Consumption: Ultra-sensitive 140mW low power consumption.
• Termination Style: Gull Wing (SMD/SMT)
